name: Inohara Riku
source:
She's been [url=/c107506]Shiori[/url]'s friend since middle school and is a second-year student at Aoba Municipal High School.
She's shy and energetic, often playing the straight man to everyone's antics, and frequently gets dragged into trouble by [url=/c105018]Kaoru[/url] and Shiori.
However, she has an abnormal love for donuts, and when faced with donuts, she completely transforms and loses all sense of normalcy.

She is good at all kinds of sports and is a member of the swimming club. While it's not a top-tier team, she is dedicated to her club activities.
Although she doesn't show it often, she is a hard worker when it comes to studying, and her grades are among the top.

She is confused by the fact that Kaoru and Shiori became close friends after a certain incident, and she is always worried about the two of them.
She harbors romantic feelings for Shiori that go beyond friendship, but she has been unable to confess her feelings for several years.

[From [url=https://lycoris-works.com/usonatsu#character]official website[/url]]
